summary: Frontend-only review of Milestone 5 Procurement UI. All 12 requested flows verified end-to-end with demo@test.com on desktop viewport (1920x1080). Inline summary panel, dedicated /procurement-decisions page, KPI/search/confidence/risk filters, Full decision cards (action pill, risk/conf badges, 3-delta cells, evidence toggle, best-alt row), Target Price Modal (open/validate/save/auto-refresh/clear), sidebar link, and probabilistic language all pass.

issues: React a11y warning: DialogContent missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}`. Non-blocking but easy fix — add <DialogDescription> inside DialogHeader or aria-describedby on DialogContent.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription to TargetPriceModal to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ProcurementUI.js TargetPriceModal: when target is cleared via the 'Clear' button, it calls api.patch with null then onSaved() — correct. Save handler also treats empty string as null → good, matches spec ('empty value + save calls PATCH with null').
ProcurementDecisionsPage.js: filter composition in useMemo is clean and composable; KPI buttons correctly toggle actionFilter. Good.
InlineDecisionCard renders `onSetTarget` only when prop passed — PriceIntelligencePage passes it so inline-target-btn-{cpid} works. Confirmed visually.
DeltaRow testids use 'delta-vs-avg' / 'delta-vs-target' / 'delta-vs-alt' — matches spec exactly. Good.

Minor: In FullDecisionCard, evidence count comes from `decision.evidence?.length` but spec text 'observation count' displayed at footer uses `decision.observation_count` — both render correctly (e.g. '8 good observations' + 'Show evidence (4)').
No hardcoded URLs — all API calls use auth api client which uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Good.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded Chicken Breast Tender Boneless Jumbo (switch_vendor, Sysco→US Foods) and Heavy Cream 40% Gallon (renegotiate, Sysco). Both HIGH/MEDIUM confirmed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Milestone 5 Procurement frontend flows verified end-to-end and working. Backend verified in iteration_88. The only non-blocking observation is a Radix DialogContent a11y warning on TargetPriceModal. If retesting after changes, demo@test.com has 2 pre-seeded items; the test exercises target save→clear round-trip which leaves the DB in its initial state.
